protocol.selection: fixed maximum depth 8; per-source risk in second arm
protocol.tuning: no tuning on these fresh sequences
protocol.main_metric: ordinary three-condition early six frame mean; oracle separately

measurement_note: Frozen-weight intervention; extra baseline current-depth diagnostic work and hashing included in wall times, not an efficiency comparison.
